items.name: tabs-url-hash

items.name: time-off-request-range

items.name: toggle-outline
items.title: Toggle buttons with outline variant
items.description: Toggle buttons with outline variant, built from the toggle component.

items.title: Tooltip Abbr Glossary

items.description: Tooltip with icon trigger, built from the tooltip component.

items.name: tooltip-status-dot
items.title: Tooltip Status Dot
items.description: A presence or status dot that is never only a colour: a focusable image named with the status in words, plus a tooltip with optional detail.

items.name: trial-bar-app-shell
items.title: Trial Bar App Shell
items.description: An app shell header with a trial bar computed from the trial end date, that hides for paying customers, turns urgent in the last three days and says ended after expiry.

items.name: update-available-snackbar
items.title: Update Available Snackbar
items.description: A snackbar that says a new version is ready with Reload and Later buttons, that does not time out because the choice matters, and that is announced once. Use this when a service worker has downloaded a new version and the person decides when to reload.

items.name: vacation-rental-minimum-stay
items.title: Vacation Rental Minimum Stay
items.description: Typed check-in and check-out dates where the minimum number of nights depends on the check-in date, such as a weekend, a holiday week or the high season. Use this when a rental host sets a longer minimum stay for some dates than for others.

items.name: validate-on-blur-then-change
items.title: Validate on Blur, then on Change
items.description: The "reward early, punish late" strategy: a field stays quiet while typing, validates when you leave it, and once it has shown an error it re-validates on every keystroke so the message clears the moment it is fixed. Use this when live validation feels nagging but a stale error feels broken.

items.name: video-playlist-now-playing
items.title: Video Playlist Now Playing
items.description: Use this when a page plays one video at a time from a list: a stage with the current video and a peeking row of cards whose pressed state shows what is playing.

items.name: watermark-trace-identity
items.title: Watermark Trace Identity
items.description: A sensitive screen whose mark combines the user's email, session id and a minute-resolution time stamp that refreshes, so a screenshot can be traced to a moment.

items.name: year-over-year-range
items.title: Year over Year Range
items.description: A day range that also shows the same dates a year earlier, moving 29 February to 28 February in non-leap years and flagging the day count mismatch. Use this when figures are read against the same dates last year and leap years must not skew the comparison.

items.name: use-animation-frame
items.title: useAnimationFrame
items.description: Run a callback on every animation frame with the elapsed time, and pause it with a flag, cleaning up its frame request on unmount.

items.name: use-async
items.title: useAsync
items.description: Run an async function and get its status, data and error, where only the latest call may update state, and nothing updates after unmount.

items.name: use-before-unload
items.title: useBeforeUnload
items.description: Ask the browser to confirm before the tab closes or reloads while there is unsaved work, and switch the guard off the moment it is saved.

items.name: use-breakpoint
items.title: useBreakpoint
items.description: Know which named breakpoint is active (Tailwind defaults or your own) and ask isAtLeast or isBelow, with a server default.

items.name: use-broadcast-channel
items.title: useBroadcastChannel
items.description: Send and receive messages between tabs, windows and iframes of the same origin, with the latest message in state and a cleanup on unmount.

items.name: use-click-outside
items.title: useClickOutside
items.description: Call a handler when a pointer press lands outside one or more elements, for closing menus, popovers and inline editors.

items.name: use-clipboard
items.title: useClipboard
items.description: Copy text to the clipboard with a copied flag that resets after a delay, an error state and a fallback for pages where the Clipboard API is blocked.

items.name: use-color-scheme
items.title: useColorScheme
items.description: Read the system light or dark preference as a string, updating live, with a server default, for canvas, charts and embeds that CSS cannot theme.

items.name: use-controllable-state
items.title: useControllableState
items.description: State that works controlled or uncontrolled: pass value to control it, or defaultValue to let the hook own it, and onChange fires either way.

items.name: use-countdown
items.title: useCountdown
items.description: A countdown from a number of seconds that does not drift, with start, pause, resume and reset, and a callback when it reaches zero.

items.name: use-counter
items.title: useCounter
items.description: A number with increment, decrement, set and reset, optional min, max and step, always clamped into range.

items.name: use-debounced-callback
items.title: useDebouncedCallback
items.description: Turn a function into one that runs only after calls have stopped for a delay, with cancel, flush and an optional leading call.

items.name: use-debounced-value
items.title: useDebouncedValue
items.description: Follow a fast-changing value only after it has settled for a delay, with an isPending flag and a flush to apply it now.

items.name: use-document-title
items.title: useDocumentTitle
items.description: Set document.title from a component, and restore the previous title when it unmounts, so each view of a single-page app names itself.

items.name: use-drag-gesture
items.title: useDragGesture
items.description: Drag an element with the pointer and keep its x and y offset in state, with axis lock, bounds, tap tolerance, spring-back and arrow-key movement as a keyboard alternative.

items.name: use-event-listener
items.title: useEventListener
items.description: Attach a typed event listener to the window, the document or an element, always calling your newest handler and removing it on cleanup.

items.name: use-fullscreen
items.title: useFullscreen
items.description: Put an element, or the page, in full screen with enter, exit and toggle, an isFullscreen flag that follows the Escape key, and a supported flag.

items.name: use-fuzzy-search
items.title: useFuzzySearch
items.description: Typo-tolerant search over a list of strings or objects with Fuse.js, returning ranked results with match positions, and a helper to highlight them.

items.name: use-hotkey
items.title: useHotkey
items.description: Bind a keyboard shortcut such as mod+k to a handler, with sensible defaults, form-field safety and a formatHotkey helper that shows the right keys for Mac and PC.

items.name: use-hover
items.title: useHover
items.description: Track whether a mouse or pen pointer is over an element, with optional open and close delays so a popover does not flicker, and touch ignored.

items.name: use-idle
items.title: useIdle
items.description: Report true after a period with no pointer, keyboard, scroll or touch activity, and false again as soon as the person returns.

items.name: use-in-view
items.title: useInView
items.description: A single true or false for whether an element is on screen, with an amount to show, a margin and a once option for reveal-on-scroll.

items.name: use-infinite-scroll
items.title: useInfiniteScroll
items.description: Call a loader when a sentinel at the end of a list scrolls near the view, again after each load while it is still visible, and stop when there is no more.

items.name: use-intersection-observer
items.title: useIntersectionObserver
items.description: Watch an element with an IntersectionObserver and get its latest entry and an isIntersecting flag, with threshold, root, margin and freeze-once-visible options.

items.name: use-interval
items.title: useInterval
items.description: A declarative setInterval: pass a delay to run a callback repeatedly, or null to pause, and the callback always sees the newest props and state.

items.name: use-is-mounted
items.title: useIsMounted
items.description: A function that tells you whether the component is still mounted, to skip state updates after an async call finishes late.

items.name: use-isomorphic-layout-effect
items.title: useIsomorphicLayoutEffect
items.description: useLayoutEffect on the client and useEffect on the server, so layout measurements never log the server-rendering warning.

items.name: use-key-held
items.title: useKeyHeld
items.description: True while a key (or any of several) is held down, resetting when the window loses focus so a stuck key never lingers.

items.name: use-key-sequence
items.title: useKeySequence
items.description: Run a callback when a sequence of keys is typed in order, such as g then i or the Konami code, with a timeout between keys.

items.name: use-latest
items.title: useLatest
items.description: A ref that always holds the newest value, so a timer, listener or async callback can read current props and state without being re-created.

items.name: use-local-storage-state
items.title: useLocalStorageState
items.description: State saved in localStorage that is safe to server-render, syncs across tabs and components, ignores unreadable values and works when storage is blocked.

items.name: use-long-press
items.title: useLongPress
items.description: Detect a press held for a set time with pointer or keyboard, with start, cancel and click handlers, and cancel when the pointer moves away.

items.name: use-media-query
items.title: useMediaQuery
items.description: Subscribe to any CSS media query and get a boolean that stays in sync, with a server default so hydration does not mismatch.

items.name: use-merged-refs
items.title: useMergedRefs
items.description: Combine several refs, callback or object, into one ref callback, so a component can forward a ref and keep its own.

items.name: use-minimum-duration
items.title: useMinimumDuration
items.description: Turn a loading flag into one that waits a short delay before showing and, once shown, stays on for a minimum time, so spinners never flash.

items.name: use-mutation-observer
items.title: useMutationObserver
items.description: Run a callback when an element's attributes, children or text change, with the observed node given as a ref, an element or a selector.

items.name: use-online-status
items.title: useOnlineStatus
items.description: True while the browser reports a network connection, updating when it goes offline or comes back, safe for server rendering.

items.name: use-page-visibility
items.title: usePageVisibility
items.description: Report whether the tab is visible or hidden, so you can pause polling, video and animation when nobody is looking.

items.name: use-pagination
items.title: usePagination
items.description: Page numbers, page ranges with ellipses and from-to counts for a paginated list or table, controlled or uncontrolled.

items.name: use-pointer-position
items.title: usePointerPosition
items.description: Track the pointer inside an element as pixels and as 0 to 1 fractions, with an inside flag, updated once per frame for spotlight, tilt and parallax effects.

items.name: use-prefers-reduced-motion
items.title: usePrefersReducedMotion
items.description: True when the person asked their system for less motion, updating live, and assuming reduced motion on the server so no animation flashes.

items.name: use-previous
items.title: usePrevious
items.description: Return the value from before the latest change, so you can compare it with the current one, for example to animate a change or detect a direction.

items.name: use-resize-observer
items.title: useResizeObserver
items.description: Measure an element and keep its width and height up to date as it resizes, with a choice of content box or border box.

items.name: use-roving-tabindex
items.title: useRovingTabindex
items.description: One tab stop for a group of items with arrow-key, Home and End movement, wrapping and RTL support, for toolbars, tab lists, radio groups and grids you build yourself.

items.name: use-scroll-direction
items.title: useScrollDirection
items.description: Report whether the page or an element is scrolling up or down, ignoring small movements, plus whether it is at the top.

items.name: use-scroll-lock
items.title: useScrollLock
items.description: Lock page scrolling while a modal, drawer or menu is open, without the layout shifting when the scrollbar disappears, and safe for nested locks.

items.name: use-scroll-position
items.title: useScrollPosition
items.description: Track the scroll offset of the window or of one element, batched to one update per frame, with horizontal and vertical values.

items.name: use-selection
items.title: useSelection
items.description: Multi-select state for rows or items with toggle, shift-click range selection, select all, and the all, some and none states a header checkbox needs.

items.name: use-set
items.title: useSet
items.description: State for a Set with add, delete, toggle, has, clear and reset that always returns a new Set, so React sees the change.

items.name: use-stable-callback
items.title: useStableCallback
items.description: A function with a stable identity that always calls the newest version of your handler, so memoised children and effects never re-run for it.

items.name: use-stopwatch
items.title: useStopwatch
items.description: A stopwatch that counts up from the clock, with start, stop, reset and lap times, and does not drift when the tab is throttled.

items.name: use-swipe
items.title: useSwipe
items.description: Detect swipes left, right, up and down on an element with a distance threshold and a time limit, returning props to spread on it.

items.name: use-theme-scope
items.title: useThemeScope
items.description: Scope a set of theme tokens to one element, so many themes can live on the same page, with an optional light, dark or inherited mode.

items.name: use-theme-transition
items.title: useThemeTransition
items.description: Run a theme change inside a View Transition with a circular reveal, falling back to an instant change when motion is reduced or unsupported.

items.name: use-throttled-callback
items.title: useThrottledCallback
items.description: Turn a function into one that runs at most once per interval, on the first call and again with the latest arguments when the interval ends.

items.name: use-throttled-value
items.title: useThrottledValue
items.description: Follow a fast-changing value at most once per interval, applying the first change at once and the latest one when the interval ends.

items.name: use-timeout
items.title: useTimeout
items.description: A declarative setTimeout with reset and clear controls, for toasts, auto-dismiss and delayed actions that follow props.

items.name: use-toggle
items.title: useToggle
items.description: A boolean you can flip, set on, set off or reset, with stable handlers, or cycle through a list of values.

items.name: use-typeahead
items.title: useTypeahead
items.description: Jump to the item whose label starts with the letters just typed, with a reset timer, for listboxes, menus and trees built from scratch.

items.name: use-undo-state
items.title: useUndoState
items.description: State with a history: set, undo, redo, jump back to a point and reset, with a cap on how many steps are kept.

items.name: use-update-effect
items.title: useUpdateEffect
items.description: An effect that skips the first run and fires only when its dependencies change afterwards, to react to changes and not to the initial value.

items.name: use-value-history
items.title: useValueHistory
items.description: Keep the last N values a variable has held, newest last, for sparklines, recent searches, change logs and trend arrows.

items.name: use-virtual-list
items.title: useVirtualList
items.description: Render only the rows in view of a very long list, with a scroll element ref, dynamic row measuring and scroll to index, built on TanStack Virtual.

items.name: use-window-size
items.title: useWindowSize
items.description: The browser window's inner width and height, updated on resize and orientation change, safe for server rendering.
